title: A Celebration of World Quality Month
summary: Quality is P&G’s enduring promise that our products will consistently earn consumers’ trust time after time after time, over billions of moments.
body_markdown:
**But our ability to deliver consistent quality with greater confidence and fewer touches is perhaps the most exciting chapter of our ever-evolving quality story.** Rapid advances in human-led, Ai-enabled predictive monitoring, real-time in-line testing, and touchless automation are taking quality management at P&G to levels of sophistication and control that would have seemed like science fiction five years ago.


This brings a double benefit: greater trust from our consumers, and greater job satisfaction in our people who work hard every day to lead these transformations.


We have a mantra that hangs in our hallways and decorates our desktops around the world — “I am the ‘i’ in Quality” — which serves as a constant reminder that every P&G employee has a responsibility to uphold our quality promise every day.


Quality is in our DNA. It’s what gets us up in the morning. But quality is not proven by a slogan. It is earned through performance, reinforced through consistency, and remembered through the trust we create, one moment at a time. I’m proud of the promise, the products, and the people who help make that possible every day.
